embed.title: Help
embed.description: Type `{{prefix}}help <command>` for details on any of the commands below.

fields.name: Tracking commands
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help track` — alerts for specific pokemon (IV, CP, level, PVP)
`{{prefix}}help raid` — raid bosses at gyms
`{{prefix}}help egg` — raid eggs before they hatch
`{{prefix}}help maxbattle` — dynamax/gigantamax battles
`{{prefix}}help quest` — field research rewards
`{{prefix}}help incident` — Team Rocket, Kecleon, Showcases, gold stops
`{{prefix}}help lure` — lure modules at pokestops
`{{prefix}}help nest` — pokemon nests
`{{prefix}}help gym` — gym team changes and battles
`{{prefix}}help fort` — new, changed and removed pokestops/gyms

fields.name: Review and remove tracking
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help tracked` — list everything you're tracking, with each rule's id
`{{prefix}}help untrack` — remove tracking
`{{prefix}}help mute` — silence a gym, pokemon, area, pokestop or one rule for a while (`{{prefix}}unmute` lifts it)
`{{prefix}}help summary` — get quests as a grouped digest at set times
`{{prefix}}help script` — export your tracking as commands you can re-run

fields.name: Look up
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help info` — pokemon details, forms, costumes, moves, items, weather, shiny and rarity stats{{#if askEnabled}}
`{{prefix}}help ask` — describe what you want in plain English and get the command for it{{/if}}

fields.name: Your account and alerts
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help poracle` — register (or re-enable) your account
`{{prefix}}help area` — choose which areas you get alerts for
`{{prefix}}help location` — set your location and save named ones
`{{prefix}}help profile` — switch between sets of tracking (home/work/weekend), on a schedule if you like
`{{prefix}}help language` — change the bot's language
`{{prefix}}help start` / `{{prefix}}help stop` — resume or pause alerts{{#if roleEnabled}}
`{{prefix}}help role` — give yourself server roles{{/if}}
`{{prefix}}help unregister` — delete your account and all tracking

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admin commands{{/if}}
fields.value:
{{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}help enable` / `{{prefix}}help disable` — manage other users
`{{prefix}}help broadcast` — send a message to users in an area
`{{prefix}}help userlist` — list registered users
`{{prefix}}help community` — area-security community membership{{/if}}

fields.name: Filter syntax (applies to most tracking commands)
fields.value: Most filters are `key:value`: `iv:100`, `cp:2000-3000`, `level:25-35`, `d:500` (distance in metres). Write ranges as `low-high`. Some options are plain words, like team names (`mystic`) or `clean`. Add `clean` to most tracking commands to have alerts deleted once they expire.
